text:
From this mauve and rose dream

that the river water dreams,

the sails of my ship

are blushing in the afternoon.


I come from distances.

I cross before the jetty.

A sailor's song

turns rosy in my heart...


Sunset. On the Plata.

I dream before the city.

I carry my sails raised,

sails of my solitude...


And with the day there go from me

-I do not know where they will go-

the lights of my joy.

translation.title: From This Mauve and Rose Dream...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the river dream, rose-colored sails, and departing lights of joy.
